releases.body:
## What's Fixed in v1.1.1

- **Config fallback fix (`src/config.ts`)**: Strip function `resolveConfig` before validating static fallback keys so `{ resolveConfig, ...fallbackOptions }` applies fallback settings when `resolveConfig(directory)` returns `undefined`.
- **Reactive TUI slot (`src/ui.tsx`)**: Use reactive `getSessionID()`, `markers`, and `uiText` accessors in `session.composer.top` slot `render`.
- **Settlement & session scope hardening (`src/ui.tsx`, `src/index.ts`)**: Added a 512-entry LRU `settledForms` tombstone against late duplicate `form.created` events, enforced `isEligibleTuiSessionSync` on TUI `session.synthetic`/`session.inbox.enqueued` handlers, and enforced `isSessionEligible` in the server `prompt` hook.
- **Draft lock & keyboard precision (`src/ui.tsx`)**: Added exclusive `flag: 'wx'` to `ensureDraftLock` (refuses symlinks), ignored non-editing navigation keys (`pageup`, `pagedown`, `home`, `end`, `scrollup`, `scrolldown`, `f1`–`f12`), and cancelled in-flight `sync` forms on typing/paste.
- **Detector, marker stripping & deduplication (`src/detector.ts`, `src/view-model.ts`, `src/handoff.ts`, `src/form-adapter.ts`)**: Scoped `commonMarkers` fallback to default marker configs, made `stripMarker` case-insensitive, moved `registerSmartQuestionsCapability` refcount to `globalThis` symbols, and deduplicated `ui.tsx` / `form-adapter.ts`.

**Verification:** 145/145 unit & regression tests, 7/7 sandbox scenarios, 8/8 live OpenCode `v2.3.0` acceptance scenarios, `tsc --noEmit`, `oxlint --deny-warnings`, and `npm audit` (0 vulnerabilities).

releases.name: v1.1.0 — Dynamic Per-Session Config, SSE Reconnect & Bounded TUI Caches
releases.body:
## 1.1.0 — 2026-11-17

- **Dynamic per-session directory config (`resolveConfig`)**: Added optional `options.resolveConfig?: (directory: string) => unknown` support in `resolveSmartQuestionConfig` (`src/config.ts`), `src/index.ts`, and `src/ui.tsx` so multi-directory hosts can resolve per-session configuration dynamically while preserving 100% standalone `.opencode/smart-question.json` behavior when omitted.
- **Event stream reconnect resilience**: Updated `context.event.subscribe` in `src/index.ts` with an `AbortController`-aware exponential backoff reconnect loop (250 ms → 30 s cap) so transient `EventBusOverflowError` or stream interruptions recover automatically without silently stopping event handling.
- **Bounded TUI remediation & chain caches**: Added 512-entry LRU eviction (`setBounded`) for `remediatedForms` and `sessionChains` in `src/ui.tsx` alongside `session.deleted` cleanup.
- **Verification**: 135/135 unit & regression tests, 7/7 sandbox scenarios, and 8/8 live OpenCode `v2.3.0` host acceptance scenarios pass (`npm run test:all`).

releases.name: v1.0.0 — Pure OpenCode V2 Plugin (OpenCode v2.3.0+)
releases.body:
## 1.0.0 — 2026-11-17

**Breaking:** Dropped OpenCode V1 support and `@opencode-ai/plugin`; Smart Questions is now a pure OpenCode V2 plugin targeting `@opencode/plugin` `^2.3.0` (`opencode v2.3.0+`).

- **Pure OpenCode V2 Server Plugin (`src/index.ts`):** Export `Plugin.define({ id: 'opencode-smart-questions', setup })`, register `session.hook('context')` and `session.hook('prompt')`, and subscribe to `context.event.subscribe` (`session.synthetic`, `session.inbox.enqueued`, `form.replied`, `form.cancelled`, `session.deleted`) with reverse-order disposal.
- **Pure OpenCode V2 TUI Plugin (`src/ui.tsx`, `scripts/emit-tui.mjs`):** Export `Plugin.define({ id: 'opencode-smart-questions.tui', setup })`, rewrite `@opencode/plugin/tui` to `opentui:runtime-module:%40opencode%2Fplugin%2Ftui`, fix `context.data.session.message.list/sync` lookup, replace non-existent `message.created` with typed V2 events, extract `SessionInfo.agent` in `resolveAgentName`, enforce draft lockfile / `canUseDraftCoordination` checks in `fire()`, and add in-flight async race guards.
- **Handoff & Protocol Fixes (`src/handoff.ts`):** Prevent Smart Questions' own synthetic remediation messages (`metadata['opencode-smart-questions'] === true`) from resetting active Guardian handoffs in `extractCurrentTurnGuardianHandoff`, and support `SessionInboxItem` payloads.
- **Verification:** 131/131 unit & regression tests, 7/7 sandbox scenarios, and 8/8 live OpenCode `v2.3.0` host acceptance scenarios pass (`npm run test:all`).

releases.name: v0.8.2 - Fallback Recommendation Preservation, In-Flight Cancellation, and Subagent Support
releases.body:
### What's Changed in v0.8.2

- **Recommendation Preservation in Fallback Mode (`ui.tsx`, `backend.ts`):**
  - In `remediate-then-fallback` policy, preserves recommended selections (including multiselect answers) across all classified questions once the remediation budget is exhausted. The V1 TUI permits that fallback instead of installing a manual-answer lock.
- **Race Condition & Duplicate Event Hardening (`ui.tsx`, `backend.ts`):**
  - Keeps rejected remediation retryable when duplicate question events arrive during network transport.
  - Preserves V2 form reply ownership (`pending.has(form.id)`) and user-interaction cancellation across duplicate form events and asynchronous `form.sync` / reply completion.
- **Ambiguous Option Label Rejection (`form-adapter.ts`):**
  - Rejects ambiguous V2 label-to-value mappings even when first-option fallback is enabled, safely classifying duplicated labels as `unclassified`.
- **Subagent Support & Lifecycle Cancellation (`session-scope.ts`, `types.ts`, `backend.ts`):**
  - Adds documented `includeSubagents` opt-in configuration while preserving root-session isolation by default.
  - Cancels in-flight V1 question handling on session deletion, user messages, settlement, and plugin disposal; rejected history lookups cannot revive cancelled work.
- **Expanded Automated Test Suite:**
  - Added 13 debugging regression tests covering remediation exhaustion, ambiguous labels, duplicate forms, and subagent session scopes.
  - 169 of 169 tests passing (100% pass) across unit, fallback, and integration scenarios.
  - 0 linter warnings / errors across 21 files.

### Highlights of v0.8.1

• **Reserved Form Field Key Preservation (`form-adapter.ts`)**:
  • Preserves own serialized answers for reserved field keys (e.g. `__proto__`) using safe object property assignment (`Object.hasOwn`).
• **Deleted Session Overlay Cleanup (`ui.tsx`)**:
  • Deleting an owning session (`session.deleted` event) now immediately releases the question lockfile and clears TUI overlay state, preventing orphaned overlays.
• **100% Passing Test Suite**:
  • 152 of 152 automated unit, fallback, visibility, and regression tests passing.
  • 10 of 10 isolated sandbox scenarios passing.
  • 0 linter warnings / errors across 19 files.
